integrity: Analytic proof is provided; numerical variance and conditional-age quadratures are corroborating calculations, not a substitute for proof. Originality is not guaranteed against inaccessible or implicit broader literature.
scientific_limitations: For the centered scalar Ornstein-Uhlenbeck diffusion and constant-rate Poisson multiplicative resets only; fixed contraction parameter below one. No joint small-reset/large-position uniformity claim.
title: Exact Gaussian stationary tails and a Gamma endpoint law for partial Ornstein–Uhlenbeck resetting
